description: This file defines an Express router handling analytics-related endpoints, including health checks, cost metrics, and user metrics. It includes route definitions with middleware for authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: HEAD /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Health check endpoint for LLM cost by agent, returning 204 No Content with specific headers.

methods.name: OPTIONS /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Preflight request handler for LLM cost by agent, returning 204 No Content.

methods.name: GET /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Retrieves LLM cost data by agent, protected by authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: GET /users/new-over-time
methods.description: Retrieves new user metrics over time, protected by authentication and tenant verification.
